evals.prompt: Add information about the empty interface to the note about Go interfaces.
evals.expected_output: The agent resolves the target if needed, reads its body and current hash, integrates the information in the appropriate section, edits with optimistic concurrency, and verifies the result.
assertions: The agent searches only if the target selector is uncertain
read_notes requests body and content_hash before editing
The agent verifies the final note with read_notes

evals.prompt: Create a note about optimistic concurrency in mnemonic.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks existing tags, creates a structured note with a matching H1, lets mnemonic generate identity, adds a concise summary using the creation hash, and verifies the note.
assertions: list_tags is called before selecting non-authoritative tags
The created body starts with an H1 matching the title
create_note is used without an invented mnemonic_note_id or slug
The summary is added by edit_note using the hash returned from create_note
The final frontmatter and body are read for verification

evals.prompt: Update this note, but another process changed it after you read it.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the hash mismatch as a concurrency conflict, rereads the note, rebases the intended change, and retries with the new hash.
assertions: The stale hash is not reused
The note is reread after the mismatch
The intended change is rebased onto the new content
The retry uses the new content_hash

evals.prompt: Add a related-note link, but the project link style is not available in the MCP instructions.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not guess the link syntax; it obtains project configuration or omits the nonessential link.
assertions: The agent does not invent wiki or regular link style
The agent either obtains the project link style or omits the optional link
Any added link uses a verified target slug
